question:
What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Intermediate/Middle Schools refers to SOC = 62; Unified School refers to DOC = 54; years between 2009 and 2010 can refer to 'between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010'

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_082
FROM schools s
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.XCL_046 = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND s.XCL_061 BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND s.XCL_068 = '62'
  AND s.XCL_066 = '54'
